summary: NuRAN Wireless Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 10, 2026 press release announcing entry into a maritime private networks pilot with an unnamed fleet management company, assessing its connectivity products for shipment tracking and fleet operations. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is disclosed; the release frames a single opportunity that could scale to up to 1,000 ships. This is an ordinary business development announcement, not a special situation, so the risk-arb angle is limited to monitoring any follow-on commercial contract disclosure.
